description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kiuleyaya, Siyambalanduwa D/S/Division Monaragala District - Cad. Map No. 720007 (24/55034)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters, specifically calling for claims to intestate property (property of deceased persons without wills) under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed land information including cadastral map numbers, parcel numbers, land extents, and locations. The content falls under the Land Gazettes category as it primarily concerns property ownership, land titles, and registration processes for specific land parcels.
